intro: Pick the reading that feels right, choose a time, and I'll take care of the rest.
readings_text: A private, face-to-face sitting with me, at weekend reading days.
video_text: The same reading, over a video call, wherever you are.
house_party_text: Private readings for each of your guests. Tell me your date, area and how many people, and I'll come back to you with details.
group_text: Evenings of mediumship and readings days at venues near you. Tickets are booked event by event.
calendar_intro: Pick a day and time below. You'll get a confirmation by email straight away.

steps.title: Choose your reading
steps.text: Pick a weekend date for an in-person reading, or a video slot from the calendar.

steps.title: Get your confirmation
steps.text: You'll receive the details of your booking, including the address or video link.

steps.title: Come with an open heart
steps.text: There's nothing to prepare. Just bring yourself, and any questions you'd like answered.

notice: Need to change your booking? Let me know at least 24 hours before so I can offer your slot to someone else.
talk_intro: Call, message or email. I'm happy to answer any questions before you book.
